title: Continuing Outlet Standing of a Workplace Cafe Management Program Client
content:
A client whose cafe management contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program is coming to an end may still hold an unattended micro market standing open under the Unattended Micro Market Program. That standing, and the weight of the market settlement invoices raised to the client, is what the continuing outlet allowance turns on.

Where the client holds an unattended micro market standing open and the market settlement invoices raised to that client over the twelve months up to the day the charge is raised reach the continuing outlet threshold, the continuing outlet allowance is the major continuing outlet rate; where the client holds an unattended micro market standing open and those settlement invoices fall below the continuing outlet threshold, the continuing outlet allowance is the minor continuing outlet rate; and where the client holds no unattended micro market standing open, the continuing outlet allowance is the nil continuing outlet rate.

The continuing outlet threshold is 90000.00 USD. The major continuing outlet rate is 35.00 per cent and the minor continuing outlet rate is 15.00 per cent. The nil continuing outlet rate means that no continuing outlet allowance is taken.

Two kinds of record are read on the client, both of them records of the Unattended Micro Market Program: the standing of the client's unattended micro market, which is what shows whether it stands open, and the market settlement invoices raised to that client, whose amounts over the twelve months up to the day the charge is raised are taken together and compared with the continuing outlet threshold.

| The client's continuing outlet standing | Continuing outlet allowance |
|---|---|
| unattended micro market standing open, settlement invoices over those twelve months reaching 90000.00 USD | the major continuing outlet rate, 35.00 per cent |
| unattended micro market standing open, those settlement invoices falling below 90000.00 USD | the minor continuing outlet rate, 15.00 per cent |
| no unattended micro market standing open | the nil continuing outlet rate, no allowance being taken |

On hypothetical figures: market settlement invoices raised to the client over those twelve months amounting to exactly 90000.00 USD reach the continuing outlet threshold, so the allowance is 35.00 per cent; amounting to 89999.99 USD they fall below it, so the allowance is 15.00 per cent; and where the client holds no unattended micro market standing open, invoicing of any size is immaterial and no continuing outlet allowance is taken.
